prompt: Implement the Deutsch-Jozsa circuit for the balanced oracle f(x) = x1 XOR x2 XOR x4 (bit 1 XOR bit 2 XOR bit 4 of the 5-bit input x; bits 0 and 3 are unused). Use qubits 0-4 as the input register and qubit 5 as the ancilla. Steps: initialize the ancilla (qubit 5) to |1> with an X gate, apply Hadamard to all 6 qubits, apply the oracle as CNOT(control=qubit 1, target=qubit 5), CNOT(control=qubit 2, target=qubit 5), and CNOT(control=qubit 4, target=qubit 5), then apply Hadamard to qubits 0-4 only (not the ancilla). Return the resulting 6-qubit state; no measurement.
